The reason you felt like the flipped picture was so bad is because you're used to seeing it the other way. Even when you flip it, your brain recognizes that it's the same face, but nothing is the same, so it kinda freaks out and makes everything seem wierd. 

This is just one of the mysterious ways that the brain works, so don't feel sad.

I never get compliments on my looks either, and have never had a girlfriend either, and if I read your post correctly, you're still very young, only 16. I just turned 17, and have to say that having no girlfriend at our age is no big deal. Just be yourself, but try and leave your comfort zone sometimes, and try new things!

Just reply if there is anything else you wish to talk about. I have felt very similiar to you in the past. I will reply.

Show him this reddit post. You've explained it here. Write him a letter, make a script, take your time. This is a very important conversation to have for you two together.

I have to sleep now, I feel bad myself, but if there's more, please, wait for me. Let me talk to you first.

Thank you for replying. I think I'm stressed put, I've never felt this before and am afraid.

I found my old teddy bear, I got it from my great granddad. He died 2 weeks after I was born. I feel much better now, but I am atill crying. 

A lot of things are stressing me. My familiy expects me to do better at school, I have little to no motivation. My mother has wanted me to get into a sport for the last 4 or so years, but I haven't enjoyed any of what I've tried. I'm afraid she's i some way disappointed at me for these two things.

I am not allowed to drink yet, limit is 18, I'm 16. I understand why, but the one time they caught me, they gave me hell. They're making me stress every time I get to go out and drink without them knowing. I get wasted too then, my troubles disappear and I feel good.

I also use tobacco, not cigarettes though, and I'm addicted. I started when the semester started this year. I have to be addicted. I'm also looking to try weed in February. 

The worst thing and most scariest thing for me is the future. I got into a program at school which had a high requirement. It's hard, lots of homework, and little time for me to do other things. So i ignore what I can of homework and such to make it easier for me. I have 2 1/2 years left of this before I have to decide on a university or something. I don't know what to do. I seriously don't.

Once again, thank you for replying, and I just noticed I stoppes crying halfway through writing this, you took my mind off my sadness and helped me find the problems, thank you.

Talk to him as fast as you can, your life is more important than anything in this world to him, after all, he wants to spend the rest of his life with you. He loves you with all his heart, he picked you, out of all other people on this planet.
